response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_rate FROM film WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_daily_rate) AS across_avg FROM per_rating), above AS (SELECT p.avg_daily_rate FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_daily_rate > o.across_avg) SELECT AVG(a.avg_daily_rate) AS avg_daily_rate_above, AVG(a.avg_daily_rate - o.across_avg) AS avg_gap_above FROM above a CROSS JOIN overall o
